title: A coffee shop in Madrid
assumptions: A new Spanish SL opening a coffee shop with staff and a fit-out. Madrid's food handler and health registration rules weren't quotable from an official page in this pass, so they aren't scored.

items.name: Limited company (SL) deed and commercial register entry
items.quote: firmen la Escritura Pública de constitución de la sociedad. Este es un trámite obligatorio.
items.quoteEn: sign the public deed of incorporation of the company. This step is mandatory.

items.name: Company tax number (NIF)
items.quote: Las personas jurídicas y entidades sin personalidad jurídica, deberán solicitar su NIF antes de realizar cualquier actividad u operación con trascendencia tributaria.
items.quoteEn: Companies and entities without legal personality must apply for their NIF before carrying out any activity or operation with tax effect.

items.name: Tax census declaration (Modelo 036) for VAT and income tax
items.quote: Debes presentar la declaración censal de alta antes del inicio de tus actividades u operaciones
items.quoteEn: You must file the census registration return before you start your activities or operations

items.name: Employer registration with Social Security (contribution account code)
items.agency: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social
items.quote: Applications for Contribution Account Codes, changes to details or end of active contributor status must be formalised by filling in the following forms:
items.agencyMatch: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social

items.name: Responsible declaration to open (or a licence where required)
items.agency: Ayuntamiento de Madrid, Agencia de Actividades (or an authorised ECU)
items.quote: Declaración responsable, con carácter general, que permite una tramitación ágil y directa.
items.quoteEn: A responsible declaration, as the general rule, which allows a quick and direct procedure.

items.name: EU food hygiene rules (Regulation (EC) 852/2004)
items.agency: European Union (Regulation (EC) 852/2004), checked by the national food inspectors
items.quote: All food businesses operating in the EU, regardless of their size or type, must comply with basic hygiene requirements.
